title: Foundation AD: cluster status (2 DCs + gateway)
description: Runs `nexus status foundation-ad` over Windows-SSH. Three rows: DC-NEXUS (pdc, the PDC emulator @ .240), DC-NEXUS-2 (dc @ .242), and nexus-gateway (gateway), all alive; leader = dc-nexus.

observe.what: 3-row table: DC-NEXUS (pdc), DC-NEXUS-2 (dc), nexus-gateway (gateway), all alive; leader = dc-nexus; overall green

whatProves: FoundationAdAdapter.GetStatusAsync reaches the two domain controllers and the gateway over Windows-SSH, classifies DC-NEXUS as the pdc, DC-NEXUS-2 as a dc, and nexus-gateway as the gateway, and rolls them into a green overall status.
